lines.beaver: 여기 처음 와 봤어. 뭐가 맛있대?
lines.beaver_en: First time here. What's good, they say?
lines.beaver_roman: Yeogi cheoeum wa bwasseo. Mwoga masitdae?
lines.en: I asked the staff, and they said the spicy fish stew is famous.

lines.beaver: 매운맛이 세? 나 매운 거 잘 못 먹어.
lines.beaver_en: Is it very spicy? I can't eat spicy food well.
lines.beaver_roman: Maeunmasi se? Na maeun geo jal mon meogeo.
lines.learner: 들어 보니 국물은 구수하고 매운맛은 약하대.
lines.en: From what I heard, the broth is savory and not very spicy.
lines.roman: Deureo boni gungmureun gusuhago maeunmaseun yakadae.

lines.beaver: 그럼 매운탕 시키자. 면도 넣을 수 있어?
lines.beaver_en: Then let's order the stew. Can we add noodles?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom maeuntang sikija. Myeondo neoeul su isseo?
lines.learner: 응, 면이나 죽 중에서 고를 수 있대.
lines.en: Yes, they said we can choose noodles or porridge.
lines.roman: Eung, myeonina juk jungeseo goreul su itdae.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, nice. Do they sell Chinese food too?
lines.learner: 아니, 중식은 없대. 메뉴판을 보니까 한식만 있어.
lines.en: No Chinese food. Looking at the menu, it's only Korean.
lines.roman: Ani, jungsigeun eopdae. Menyupaneul bonikka hansingman isseo.

lines.beaver_en: What about drinks? Is there wine?
lines.en: No wine, but they say the ginseng tea is good.

lines.learner: 전에 마셔 보니까 쓰지 않고 달콤했어.
lines.en: When I tried it before, it wasn't bitter. It was sweet.
lines.roman: Jeone masyeo bonikka sseuji anko dalkomhaesseo.

lines.en: There's braised ribs, and they say the meat is very tender.

lines.beaver: 아침을 안 먹어서 배가 너무 고파.
lines.beaver_en: I skipped breakfast, so I'm really hungry.
lines.beaver_roman: Achimeul an meogeoseo baega neomu gopa.
lines.en: I'm hungry too. Let's order everything.
They said peaches and yogurt come out. It's free!

lines.beaver: 와, 여기 정말 좋다. 다음에 또 오자.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, this place is great. Let's come again.
lines.beaver_roman: Wa, yeogi jeongmal jota. Daeume tto oja.
lines.learner: 응, 꼭 또 오자! 오늘은 남김없이 다 먹자.
lines.en: Yeah, let's definitely come again! Let's eat every bite today.
lines.roman: Eung, kkok tto oja! Oneureun namgimeopsi da meokja.
